run_fastcsp_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config file and selected stages
run_fastcsp_default_stages: run the FastCSP workflow with default stages generate process_generated relax and filter
run_fastcsp_custom_stages: run the FastCSP workflow with custom stages like generate and relax only
run_fastcsp_evaluate: run the FastCSP workflow including the evaluate stage to compare against experimental structures
run_fastcsp_free_energy: run the FastCSP workflow with the free_energy stage to compute free energy corrections
